mapper.sql: key_type_id AS keyTypeId, key_type_code AS keyTypeCode, key_type_name AS keyTypeName, group_name AS groupName, value_type AS valueType, default_role AS defaultRole, entry_allowed AS entryAllowed, value_pattern AS valuePattern, input_hint AS inputHint, sort_no AS sortNo, description, status, version, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime

where.if: AND (key_type_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR key_type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_query_key_type (key_type_id, key_type_code, key_type_name, group_name, value_type, default_role, entry_allowed, value_pattern, input_hint, sort_no, description, status, version, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.keyTypeId}, #{row.keyTypeCode}, #{row.keyTypeName}, #{row.groupName}, #{row.valueType}, #{row.defaultRole}, #{row.entryAllowed}, #{row.valuePattern}, #{row.inputHint}, #{row.sortNo}, #{row.description}, #{row.status}, #{row.version}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.updatedBy}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_query_key_type WHERE key_type_id = #{keyTypeId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_query_key_type WHERE key_type_code IN #{code}
SELECT FROM t_query_key_type WHERE key_type_code IN #{code} ORDER BY key_type_id FOR SHARE
SELECT FROM t_query_key_type ORDER BY sort_no, key_type_code
SELECT FROM t_query_key_type ORDER BY key_type_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM t_query_key_type
ORDER BY sort_no, key_type_code LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_query_key_type SET key_type_name = #{next.keyTypeName}, group_name = #{next.groupName}, value_type = #{next.valueType}, default_role = #{next.defaultRole}, entry_allowed = #{next.entryAllowed}, value_pattern = #{next.valuePattern}, input_hint = #{next.inputHint}, sort_no = #{next.sortNo}, description = #{next.description}, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{next.updatedBy}, update_time = #{next.updateTime} WHERE key_type_id = #{row.keyTypeId} AND version = #{row.version}
